AuditSession.title: AuditSession
AuditSession.description: Historical security audit inspection session stored in Firestore

report.description: Reference (e.g., URL, ID) to an encrypted security report stored in a dedicated, highly secure external vault (e.g., cloud storage with KMS). This field should not directly contain sensitive vulnerability details, exploits, or code snippets to prevent OWASP A01:2021-Broken Access Control and data leakage risks. Direct access to the full report requires strong authentication and authorization to the external resource.

WebhookEvent.title: WebhookEvent
WebhookEvent.description: Incoming GitHub webhook CI/CD execution log

LinkedRepository.title: LinkedRepository
LinkedRepository.description: GitHub repository directly linked to user profile for automatic re-audits on main branch push

/audit_sessions/{sessionId}.description: Stores individual security audit session reports

/webhook_events/{eventId}.description: Stores inbound webhook triggers and verification history

/linked_repositories/{repoId}.description: Stores GitHub repositories linked to audit profiles for auto re-audit on push
